# Blossom

Blossom gives Obsidian a soft, floral-inspired palette with gentle contrasts and typography its recorded description calls readable. Spacing stays consistent and accents subtle, and both light and dark modes are covered.

![Blossom screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blossomtheme/Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot01.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Blossom"
    author: "blossomtheme"
    repo:   "blossomtheme/Obsidian"
    slug:   "blossom"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/blossom"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/blossomtheme/Obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/blossomtheme/Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot01.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Blossom to give Obsidian a soft, floral-inspired color palette with gentle contrasts and clear, readable typography. Use consistent spacing and subtle accents to create a calm, focused writing environment across light and dark modes."
}
```
